unlisted_practices: Operationalize abstract speech constructs into objective, quantifiable speech measures with established construct validity rather than relying on high-dimensional, nonspecific speech features in clinical speech analytics models.
Validate digital clinical speech measures using the V3 framework (verification, analytical validation, clinical validation).
Standardize the implementation of speech measures across labs to promote consistency and replication.
Establish the test-retest reliability of digital speech measures.
Establish that changes in a digital speech measure are clinically meaningful to patients.

screen.reason: This is a framework/research note advocating for a methodological approach (transitioning from high-dimensional features to clinically validated measures using the V3 validation framework) in clinical speech analytics, illustrated by a case study.
